**Finding: COMPLIANT (at the preferred position) — no redline proposed.**

MINCOMMIT is satisfied. IBM carries no minimum purchase, volume or take-or-pay obligation:

| Element | Where met |
|---|---|
| No minimum purchase/volume commitment | SOW § 11.2(d) (p0882): forecasts "do not obligate IBM to purchase any Product"; § 6.0 (p0720): Agreement "does not authorize MSL to produce or deliver any Product" |
| Pay only for ordered Products | § 1.8 (p0065): only IBM Customer Orders / Purchase Orders authorize build; § 11.2 (p0870): production "according to actual intake of IBM Customer Orders" |
| Exit | § 6.1 (p0722): IBM may cancel any and all Purchase Orders at any time |

The forecast/flexibility exposure the planner asked us to test is not take-or-pay: Appendix 4 Supply Flexibility is an **MSL** obligation with "no liability for unused flexibility" (§ 13.2(e)); § 13.0(f) gives IBM no inventory liability within the forecast-accuracy parameters; and the § 5.2/5.3 termination buyout is confined to non-cancellable Parts priced at **MSL's cost** — a true-up, not a shortfall penalty. The Appendix 2 Requirements Accuracy compensation is a materials-cost true-up on IBM's own forecast; noted in the rationale as a sub-preferred wrinkle (percentages redacted) rather than flagged, per the playbook's treatment of minor sub-elements.
